title: Owia a Ɛpue Pon no Sohwɛfo
intro: Wɔ Kur’aan no nyinaa mu no, akra binom twa asase no so gyaw nyansa ne anwonwade akwan. Onipa a ɔte saa no mu biako tuu kwan kɔɔ abɔde mu mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri paa—baabi a owia pue na ɛkɔtɔ, baabi a akwanside bi siw basabasayɛ ankasa ano. Wɔmaa Allah akoa yi ahennie a obiara rennya bio. Ɛdenam akwantu ahorow abiɛsa a ɛsono emu biara so no, onipa yi atirimpɔw daa adi pefee. So wubetumi ahu saa anansesɛm mu ɔkwantufo yi afi abakɔsɛm sunsuma mu?
clues: Mmɔborohunufo Panyin no maa me tumi sɛ minni asase so wɔ ɔkwan a obiara nnya nyɛɛ so da so.
Mituu kwan kɔɔ atɔe fam kosii sɛ miduu baabi a owia kɔtɔ, na mihui sɛ ɛrekɔtɔ wɔ asubura bi a emu yɛ kusuu mu, na mihuu nnipa bi a wɔwɔ hɔ no.
Metuu kwan kɔɔ apuei fam kɔsii sɛ meduruu baabi a owia pue, na mehunuu sɛ ɛrepue wɔ nkurofoɔ bi a Yemmaa dabere biara amma wɔn so.
Mituu kwan faa saa mmeae abien a ɛyɛ hu no ntam kosii sɛ miduu bon bi a ɛda mmepɔw abien ntam mu, faako a mihuu nnipa bi a ɛkame ayɛ sɛ wontumi nte kasa ase.
Mihuu dade akwanside abien a ɛyɛ den a ɛkɔ nifa ne benkum wɔ bepɔw no so, na ɔkwan teateaa bi wɔ wɔn ntam. Saa nkurɔfo yi ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ memmu akwanside a esiw basabasayɛ ano no mu.

Mefaa me nsiesiei no na mekae sɛ: ‘Sɛ akwanside no bu a, eyi bɛyɛ mpaapaemu a ɛda adi pefee wɔ yɛne nkurɔfo yi ntam.’ Na bere a bere a wɔahyɛ no dui no, mehwɛɛ sɛnea awiei koraa no wobu akwanside no so no.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
